body.text: Follow user manuals and training guidelines. Handle equipment with care to prevent damage. Perform routine cleaning and basic maintenance as directed.

Off-Site Security: When equipment is taken off-site, use secure transport and storage methods. Avoid exposing devices to high-risk environments that could lead to theft or data breaches.

Equipment Return: All equipment must be returned promptly once the authorized use period ends or upon employee departure. Confirm receipt and condition via a formal sign-off process.

This SOP establishes the sustainable procurement practices at Jay Finechem, a chemical manufacturing company, to ensure that procurement decisions consider environmental stewardship, ethical governance, and social responsibility. It also mandates adherence to the company’s Supplier Code of Conduct.

This procedure applies to the procurement of all goods and services, including raw materials, equipment, utilities, chemicals, and third-party services. It covers new and existing suppliers at all levels of the supply chain.

To integrate sustainability principles into procurement policies and day-to-day purchasing activities.
To ensure all suppliers comply with Jay Finechem’s Supplier Code of Conduct.
To promote environmental performance, fair labor practices, and ethical governance among suppliers.
To enhance supplier diversity, including engagement of women-owned, minority-led, and vulnerable-group enterprises.
To ensure procurement decisions are aligned with long-term ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance) goals.

Supplier Code of Conduct Compliance: All suppliers must acknowledge and comply with the company’s Supplier Code of Conduct, covering areas such as human rights, business ethics, environmental responsibility, and workplace safety.
Environmental Sustainability: Procurement prioritizes environmentally responsible suppliers who actively reduce emissions, conserve resources, and minimize hazardous waste.
Social Accountability: Suppliers must ensure decent working conditions, fair wages, health and safety measures, and prohibit child or forced labor.
Supplier Diversity: We actively promote engagement with diverse suppliers, including women-owned, minority-owned, and vulnerable-group-owned businesses. Our procurement process gives priority to businesses that are registered with certified diversity bodies or local/national associations for women, minorities, veterans, disabled persons, and LGBTQ+ communities.
Supplier diversity is a measurable target under our sustainability program, and vendors are requested to voluntarily self-declare ownership classifications during onboarding and assessments.
Governance and Ethics: All procurement decisions must be free from favoritism, corruption, or conflicts of interest, and suppliers are expected to uphold high ethical standards.

Pre-Qualification and ESG Screening

Suppliers are screened for diversity ownership status during onboarding. The supplier onboarding form includes a classification section where vendors indicate if they are owned by women, minorities, or underrepresented groups.
Jay Finechem prioritizes vendors registered with organizations like We connect International, MSME India (Women/SC/ST Category), or similar recognized certification authorities.

On-site Supplier Audits

Scheduled on-site audits are conducted for strategic or high-risk suppliers to evaluate compliance with sustainability practices, occupational health and safety, DEI, Social, Environmental and the Supplier Code of Conduct.
Observations from audits are documented, and corrective action plans are shared with suppliers for implementation.

Supplier Worker Feedback Surveys

Anonymous surveys are periodically conducted to gather feedback from supplier employees regarding working conditions, safety, grievance mechanisms, and fair treatment.
Results are analyzed for red flags and used to assess supplier alignment with the Code of Conduct.

Annual Assessments

Existing suppliers undergo annual sustainability performance reviews based on defined ESG KPIs, audit results, and survey feedback.
Non-compliant suppliers may be issued warnings, placed under corrective monitoring, or discontinued.
